description: Create a project, or update one you own. One owner may own many isolated projects; a project archive holds desensitised fields only (type, stage, capability ids, tag preferences, confirmed used-tool ids, explicitly rejected tool ids) — never send a project name, code, raw chat, path or free text (dropped and reported as dropped_fields). Needs the followup consent scope (consent_update first). Omit project_id to create (returns project_id + a project_token shown once); pass expected_version to guard concurrent updates (version_conflict on mismatch); rotate_token:true (owner credential only) invalidates all old project tokens and returns a new one.
name: project_upsert
title: Create or update a project
